Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The agent relied on an incorrect Discogs “master” page with an 8-track listing that does not represent the actual Back to Mono box set track order. This led to misidentifying the opening track as “Every Breath I Take” (Goffin/King) instead of cross-verifying authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia, liner notes) that show the box set opens with “To Know Him Is to Love Him,” written by Phil Spector and inspired by a tombstone inscription. The failure to confirm edition differences and to validate sources caused the investigation to veer toward a wrong conclusion.
